summary.content:
Today's selection covers 85 articles from 8 trusted sources, including 56 on Artificial Intelligence and 18 on Fraud/Cybersecurity.

• **AI Spotlight**: 'I thought he was going to hit me,' OpenAI co-founder says of Musk
• **Companies in Focus**: Coverage includes developments from OpenAI, Google, Anthropic
• **Security Alert**: Live updates from Elon Musk and Sam Altman’s court battle over the future of OpenAI
• **Threat Landscape**: Today's coverage highlights ransomware, phishing, data breaches
• **Source Diversity**: Articles sourced from BBC Technology, NY Times Tech, The Verge, BleepingComputer, TechCrunch and others
• **Fresh Content**: 62 articles published in the last 24 hours
